source_title: Why Porto allowed Juventus to sign Conceicao on straight loan deal
evidence_text: FC Porto president Andre Villas-Boas said: "We made this agreement with Juventus on loan without a buy option: A loan of €7m that can go up to €10m." The article describes the move as a straight, season-long loan.

source_title: Porto lower demands for Juventus loanee and transfer target Conceicao
evidence_text: The report states that Conceicao joined Juventus on a straight loan for the 2024-25 season. Juventus paid €7m plus up to €3m in bonuses, and the deal did not include an option to buy. It also states that the original deal had no option or obligation to buy.
